summary: No blocking security vulnerabilities found in the tracked CLEANUP-01 provider-boundary architecture-gate diff. Raw HTTP LLM provider hosts and names, generated production directories, direct provider sends, ignored-source imports, package classifications, and exact exception ratchets were reviewed.
residual_risks: Fully dynamic provider URL construction or config-derived fetch targets can still evade static regex scans.
Provider host and dependency patterns must be updated when adding new model backends.
Exact migration exceptions still allow current provider-boundary debt by file and count until the named migration phases are complete.
